candidate_exposure: Fit gets train-only cases. Predict gets query-only cases and its own original captured fitted state. Timing gets no neural arrays/reference. Original source/mapping/keys/target selectors stay with the trusted host.

outcomes.detector: Equal-person Siena event-F1, sensitivity, false alarms per24 observed hours and full frozen contrasts; source folds reported separately.
outcomes.reconstruction: Participant reconstruction of frozen analysis quantities, tolerance1e-8, separate from detector performance.

permanent_interpretation_limits: Retrospective full-record filtering and query transduction are permitted; this is not online detection.
Arbitrary code may ignore training or interpret fitted state itself; operational phase order does not prove semantic training use.
Source folds share training people and target predictions share one fitted model; descriptive SE is not an independent population SE.
Native/harmonized contrasts bundle montage, channel count, filtering and sampling; age/hardware/clinical context confound transfer.
Public source data and labels require an honest contamination policy.

selection.C2: EDF-origin profile conditional on genuine adjudication; both clock conflicts remain unresolved
selection.F2: separate fit and predict with original captured fitted-state ownership
selection.M1: measured18-edge CHB support; publisher-whitelisted Siena common-reference subtraction requires genuine interpretation
selection.O1: exact reference source controls preprocessing claims; arbitrary signal programmes are bundled-method comparisons
selection.T1: exact pinned parser and all47 original Siena event entries

source_audit: 23 CHB leave-one-person-out fits per arm,22 training people each; all files of a held person remain together.
target_transfer: One full23-person CHB fit per arm predicts all41 Siena recordings/14 people together; no Siena target labels in fit or predict payloads.
